import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
class RegexObserver {
  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    if (args[0].equals("word")) {
      Pattern word = Pattern.compile("(?U)\\w");
      int start = -1;
      for (int cp = 0; cp <= 0x110000; cp++) {
        boolean matches = cp < 0x110000 && word.matcher(new String(Character.toChars(cp))).matches();
        if (matches && start < 0) start = cp;
        if (!matches && start >= 0) { System.out.println(start + "\t" + (cp - 1)); start = -1; }
      }
      return;
    }
    var patterns = Files.readAllLines(Path.of(args[0]));
    var samples = Files.readAllLines(Path.of(args[1]));
    for (int i = 0; i < patterns.size(); i++) {
      var p = Pattern.compile(new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(patterns.get(i)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
      for (int j = 0; j < samples.size(); j++) {
        var s = new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(samples.get(j)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        System.out.println(i + "\t" + j + "\t" + p.matcher(s).find() + "\t" + p.matcher(s).matches());
      }
    }
  }
}
